lines.text: Check dates, signs, transfers and totals before categorizing a bank CSV, then add future bills so past transactions become a usable budget input.

eyebrow.text: Run the import in this order

items.text: Download through the bank's official website and record the account, date range and export settings.
Keep the original untouched and work from a copy in a restricted location.
Preview the file without enabling formulas or active content.
Identify the date format, currency, delimiter and amount or debit/credit columns.
Map transaction amounts, not the running balance, to the amount field.
Compare transaction count and inflow/outflow totals with the same bank activity period.

line.text: Transactions you enter or import, reviewed before anything joins your picture, so what you are looking at is what actually happened.
